subject: Onboarding: three questions only a person can answer
body: 1) Accept or change D-onboarding-002: text chat with Claude (claude-sonnet-5-5) behind it, optional browser speech, and a deterministic scripted path as the demo default so it runs offline. Earlier docs assumed GPT Live 1. 2) How much of onboarding is scripted on stage: the whole conversation, or one emotion live and two pre-filled? 3) Calibration length: 20 s per emotion (my choice, fits the demo) or ~60 s (coord/lanes.json)?
